add.k: A New York cab driver Spider-Man once saved
st: In season 3, Mousie, a cabbie Spider-Man once saved, helps Taina find him and leads her fellow drivers to free him from Doctor Octopus.

files.notes: Episode 30 (Attack of the Octobot). The fan wiki lists an 'S.O.S. cab company'; no source confirms that name on screen, so Independent. Springfield has transcripts only for the first five episodes of the 1994 series, so her name rests on the Marvel Database synopsis ('a cab driver called Mousie').

k: A retired professor who knew the Six Warriors
A professor, secretly the Black Marvel
st: In season 5, Omar tells Peter the Six Warriors' story, is revealed as the Black Marvel and fights the Kingpin, the Red Skull and Electro.

files.notes: Episodes 54 to 58. Revealed as the Black Marvel in episode 57 (The Six Fight Again), so the Warriors group and alias are staged there. He was a member since the war, but that stays secret until the reveal. Retired because the five go back into retirement at the end.

st: In season 3, Randy joins a gang, tries to steal his father's revolver and is set up by Tombstone, until Spider-Man talks him round.

files.notes: Episode 36 (Tombstone). 'Bandana Gang' is the Marvel Database name; I could not confirm it is said on screen (no transcript), so check it. He leaves the gang at the end of episode 36, so Independent is keyed to episode 37. The fan wiki also lists him in a flashback in episode 42 (Guilty); I gave that no step because it is recap footage.

k: Peter's late father, an American spy
st: In season 3, an illusion of Richard, conjured by Baron Mordo, greets Peter beside Mary and draws him into Mordo's cult.
In season 5, he and Mary are shown as American spies who leave their evidence on the Red Skull's Doomsday device with Dr. Groitzig.

files.notes: A cartoon version of a name the app uses elsewhere, so no name test. Episode 28 shows Mordo's illusion of him; episode 55 shows him in a flashback (and only a photo in 54). The fan wiki pages disagree on who gave whom the evidence; the Mary Parker and Illyena pages say the Parkers left it with Groitzig, so I followed that. The spy agency is never named in the sources, so Independent.

add.k: A troubled teen Peter tutors in science
st: In season 3, Robert steals a gang's jet tech to build a rocket skateboard and robs a jeweler, then helps Spider-Man stop the Big Wheel.

files.notes: Episode 32 (Rocket Racer). I used 'Robert Farrell' as the name because the synopses use it. 'Rocket Racer' is the episode title, but I could not confirm it is said to him, so it is only an alias. He attends a science class (the fan wiki says the Hardy Foundation), but the name is unconfirmed, so Independent.

add.k: A speedster of the Six American Warriors
st: In season 5, the Whizzer reunites with the Six American Warriors and fights the Kingpin, the Red Skull and Electro beside Spider-Man.

files.notes: First seen in the wartime story in episode 56, then on screen in 57 and 58. The Marvel Database credits him as 'Whizzer (Bob Frank)'. I could not confirm 'Bob Frank' is said, so the file uses Whizzer and has no alias.

st: In season 4, Sarah helps Scorpion save for a cure, then frees the Vulture to rescue him after Alistair Smythe captures him.

files.notes: Episode 46 (Partners); only mentioned in 53. The synopsis calls her only 'Sarah'. I found no source showing the surname Baker on screen, so the name is just Sarah; change it if a transcript gives Baker. The fan wiki calls her his fiancee.

add.k: A scientist the Kingpin assigns to Johnathon Ohnn
st: In season 3, Dr. Lopez helps Johnathon Ohnn open portals, tells the Kingpin of his powers, is taken hostage and follows him into limbo.

files.notes: Episode 39 (The Spot). I put her in Fisk's Empire because she works for and reports to the Kingpin. Her main tie would be Johnathon Ohnn (the Spot), who is in batch 73 and not in network_people, so I left that tie out.

st: In season 3, Agent Choi ambushes Peter for his disc and passes Matt Murdock's evidence to Richard Fisk, until Terri Lee arrests her.

files.notes: Episodes 33 and 34, plus a cameo in Smythe's memories in 35. The Wikipedia summary of episode 33 (Framed) already calls her 'federal agent Susan Choi', and the Marvel Database synopsis of 34 uses 'Agent Choi' and 'Susan Choi', so the full name is used from her first title and needs no staging. No transcript was available. Her agency is never named, so Independent.

st: In season 2, Vanessa is kidnapped by Tombstone for Silvermane and rescued by her husband's men, then leaves Wilson over his life of crime.

files.notes: A cartoon version of a name the app uses elsewhere. Episodes 24 and 25. She is only in a photo in 34, so I gave that no step.

add.k: An Oscorp scientist working with Norman Osborn
st: In season 3, Dr. Stromm helps Norman Osborn make the Kingpin's gas, is pulled from the burning lab by Spider-Man and is pressed to keep working.

files.notes: Episode 31 (Enter the Green Goblin). His appearance in 40 is recap footage only. I did not confirm 'Wardell' is said; the name comes from the synopses and Wikipedia.

add.k: A scientist the Red Skull forced to build a weapon
st: In season 5, Dr. Groitzig, forced to build the Red Skull's Doomsday device, resurfaces, is seized for the Skull and is freed by the Six Warriors.

files.notes: On screen in episodes 54 and 57, and in flashbacks in 55 and 56. The synopses and Wikipedia call him 'Dr. Groitzig' (Wikipedia spells it Grotizick). The Marvel Database credits 'Dr. Wolfgang Groitzig', but I could not confirm 'Wolfgang' is said, so the name is Dr. Groitzig. He served the Red Skull by force, but no group name is confirmed on screen, so Independent.

add.k: A sorcerer who teaches Stephen Strange
st: In season 3, the Ancient One takes in the injured Stephen Strange, defeats his scheming student Baron Mordo and makes Strange his pupil.

files.notes: A cartoon version of a name the app uses elsewhere. Seen only in Strange's origin story in episode 28. I put him in the group the app uses for this version of Doctor Strange.

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Taina meets Mousie at a police station after Doctor Octopus brainwashes Spider-Man, and Mousie agrees to help. Together they rally the city's cab drivers and crash into Ock's hideout to free him.
stages.whoA: Taina, the girl she helps save Spider-Man
stages.whoB: Mousie, the cab driver who helps her

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man once saved Mousie, and when Doctor Octopus wipes his memory she follows him across the city. Caught by Ock, she urges Spider-Man to remember who he is until he recovers.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, whom she frees from Doctor Octopus
stages.whoB: Mousie, a cabbie who helps restore his memory

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Mousie trails Doctor Octopus and his brainwashed partner Spider-Man around New York. Ock catches her and is about to get rid of her when her fellow drivers crash in, and he is arrested.
stages.whoA: Doctor Octopus, who brainwashes Spider-Man
stages.whoB: Mousie, a cab driver who foils him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter and Robbie visit Omar Mosely, who tells them the story of the Six American Warriors. Omar later reveals he is the Black Marvel and fights beside Spider-Man against the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who fights beside the Warriors
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, who tells him of the Six Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie and Peter visit Omar to learn the Warriors' history. Omar later shows Robbie where the last keys are hidden, but that Robbie is the Chameleon in disguise, who grabs the keys.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, a Bugle editor he confides in
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, a professor who knew the Warriors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Omar fought beside Captain America as the Black Marvel in the war and later tried for years to free him from the vortex. When Cap returns, they fight the Red Skull together until Cap is pulled back in.
stages.whoA: Captain America, his wartime teammate
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Omar and the Whizzer served together in the Six American Warriors. Reunited fifty years later, they battle the Kingpin's Insidious Six, the Red Skull and Electro beside Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Whizzer, his teammate in the Six
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin steals the Warriors' keys to claim the Red Skull's Doomsday device. Omar and the Warriors fight him and his Insidious Six for the last key, but Fisk escapes with it.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who hunts the Warriors' keys
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Black Marvel fought the Red Skull in the war. When the Skull returns from the vortex and turns his son into Electro, Omar and the Warriors help Spider-Man defeat them.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Warriors' old foe
stages.whoB: Omar Mosely, the Black Marvel

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Robbie learns his son Randy has been skipping school and running with a gang, and catches him taking his old service revolver. When Tombstone takes Randy, Robbie goes to face him, and the family sorts out its problems.
stages.whoA: Robbie Robertson, his father
stages.whoB: Randy, his son

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Randy's gang turns out to be led by Tombstone, who plans to frame the boy to pressure Robbie. Spider-Man shows Randy he has been set up, and Tombstone is arrested.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, the gang boss who sets him up
stages.whoB: Randy, Robbie's son he uses as bait

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man catches Randy in a carjacking with the gang. At the chemical plant he talks to Randy before fighting and convinces him that Tombstone has set him up.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who sets him straight
stages.whoB: Randy, Robbie's son

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo shows Peter an illusion of his parents, and Richard welcomes his son. The vision binds Peter to Mordo's cult until Doctor Strange frees him.
stages.whoA: Peter, his son
stages.whoB: Richard Parker, his late father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Told that his parents were traitors, Peter goes to Russia to clear their names. He learns Richard and Mary were American spies working against the Red Skull's Doomsday device.
stages.whoA: Peter, his son
stages.whoB: Richard Parker, his late father

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spying on the Red Skull's Doomsday device, Richard and Mary go to Dr. Groitzig, who was forced to build it. Fearing they will not escape alive, they leave their evidence with him.
stages.whoA: Dr. Groitzig, who keeps his evidence
stages.whoB: Richard Parker, an American spy

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Peter tutors Robert in science, but Robert drops out after a night in a cell. Spider-Man finds out Robert is the rocket thief, and together they wreck the Big Wheel and stop his gang.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, his science tutor
stages.whoB: Robert Farrell, a student he tutors

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Felicia takes Robert's mother to collect him from the police station and tells Peter what happened. Later she drives Robert to his mother after she collapses, with the Big Wheel in pursuit.
stages.whoA: Felicia Hardy, who looks out for his family
stages.whoB: Robert Farrell, a student she looks out for

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Whizzer got his speed from a flawed copy of the formula that made Captain America, and fought beside him in the war. When Cap returns from the vortex, the Whizzer fights with him against the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Captain America, leader of the Six
stages.whoB: The Whizzer, a speedster of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man seeks out the Six American Warriors before the Kingpin can. The Whizzer joins him against the Insidious Six and later against the Red Skull and Electro.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who teams with the Six
stages.whoB: The Whizzer, a speedster of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: In the war, the Whizzer and the Warriors tried to stop the Red Skull's doomsday plot. Fifty years later he fights the freed Skull again and helps defeat him.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, the Warriors' old foe
stages.whoB: The Whizzer, one of the Six

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Sarah stands by the Scorpion as he tries to pay for a cure from Curt Connors. When Alistair Smythe captures him, she frees the Vulture so he can go and save him.
stages.whoA: Scorpion, the man she loves
stages.whoB: Sarah, his partner

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Scorpion has been holding the Vulture hostage. Sarah releases him so he can rescue the Scorpion from Smythe, and in the chaos the Vulture regains his youth.
stages.whoA: The Vulture, whom she frees to save Scorpion
stages.whoB: Sarah, the Scorpion's partner who frees him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Smythe captures the Scorpion to use his DNA in an experiment for Silvermane. Sarah frees the Vulture, who breaks up the experiment, and Smythe's lab explodes.
stages.whoA: Alistair Smythe, who captures the Scorpion
stages.whoB: Sarah, the Scorpion's partner

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin assigns Silvia to Johnathon Ohnn's portal project, and she reports Ohnn's new powers to him. Fisk then takes her hostage to force Ohnn to capture Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, her employer
stages.whoB: Dr. Silvia Lopez, a scientist he controls

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Agent Choi works in Richard Fisk's plot to frame Peter Parker for treason. She hands Richard the disc that could clear Peter, and both are arrested and convicted.
stages.whoA: Richard Fisk, whose frame-up she serves
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, a corrupt federal agent

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Agent Choi ambushes Peter for his diagnostic disc, but he escapes as Spider-Man. She later takes the evidence that could clear him, until her arrest helps prove his innocence.
stages.whoA: Peter Parker, whom she helps frame
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, a corrupt agent who frames him

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Detective Terri Lee watches Agent Choi hand the disc to Richard Fisk and suspects Peter was framed. She arrests Choi when the police raid the hideout.
stages.whoA: Terri Lee, the detective who arrests her
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, a corrupt agent she arrests

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Matt Murdock gives the data disc to Agent Choi, unaware she is part of the plot against his client Peter. Daredevil and Terri Lee then save Peter and Mary Jane, and Choi is arrested.
stages.whoA: Matt Murdock, whom she deceives
stages.whoB: Agent Choi, who takes his evidence

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Vanessa is dining with her husband Wilson when Tombstone kidnaps her for Silvermane. Once she is back, she tells Wilson she is leaving him because of his criminal life.
stages.whoA: Wilson Fisk, her husband
stages.whoB: Vanessa Fisk, his wife

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Tombstone kidnaps Vanessa so that Silvermane can force the Kingpin to hand over the Tablet of Time. He brings her to a hostage exchange that Alistair Smythe's robot breaks up.
stages.whoA: Tombstone, who kidnaps her
stages.whoB: Vanessa Fisk, the Kingpin's wife he kidnaps

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Norman and Dr. Stromm race to perfect the gas the Kingpin demands. Norman's carelessness sets off a blast that nearly kills Stromm and seems to kill Norman.
stages.whoA: Norman Osborn, his boss at Oscorp
stages.whoB: Wardell Stromm, his Oscorp scientist

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Kingpin forces Oscorp to make a gas for use as a chemical weapon. After the explosion, he orders Stromm to keep working on it anyway.
stages.whoA: The Kingpin, who forces him to make gas
stages.whoB: Wardell Stromm, an Oscorp scientist he coerces

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Spider-Man pulls Stromm out of the burning Oscorp building, and Stromm tells him Norman is still inside.
stages.whoA: Spider-Man, who saves him from the fire
stages.whoB: Wardell Stromm, a scientist he saves

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: The Red Skull forced Dr. Groitzig to build his Doomsday device in the war and then tried to have him killed. Freed from the vortex, the Skull has him taken again, and the Six American Warriors save him.
stages.whoA: The Red Skull, who forced him to build the device
stages.whoB: Dr. Groitzig, the scientist he forced

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Stephen Strange, a surgeon whose hands were ruined in an accident, seeks a cure from the Ancient One, who offers to teach him. After the Ancient One defeats Baron Mordo, Strange becomes his student.
stages.whoA: Stephen Strange, his new student
stages.whoB: The Ancient One, his teacher

stages.title: Spider-Man (1994)
stages.text: Baron Mordo, the Ancient One's student, plots to destroy his master and take his place. The Ancient One sees through the scheme and defeats him.
stages.whoA: Baron Mordo, the student who betrays him
stages.whoB: The Ancient One, the master he betrays

dropped.why: No plot summary shows the name used on screen: the Marvel Database synopsis of episode 54 and the Wikipedia summaries of episodes 54 to 58 never name him (Wikipedia calls him only 'an informant'); 'Lentz' appears only in Marvel Database cast lists and a location label, and no 1994 transcript is available.

changes.was: Compound file sv-lentz-1994 with two ties
changes.why: No plot summary shows the name used on screen: the Marvel Database synopsis of episode 54 and the Wikipedia summaries of episodes 54 to 58 never name him (Wikipedia calls him only 'an informant'); 'Lentz' appears only in Marvel Database cast lists and a location label, and no 1994 transcript is available.
The Wikipedia plot summary of her first episode (33, Framed) already names her 'federal agent Susan Choi', so 'Susan Choi' is not first used in 34 and the staging is wrong.
